gameDescriptionHtml:
SHAKHTER-ONE:
Horrors wake up once again on board Shakhter-One. The history of Mark’s mental tragedy and family life comes clearer with every minute spent on this hollowed spaceship. The curse of a never-ending loop can only be stopped by one thing – the truth. But all the secrets are kept jealously by these dark corridors blended with Mark’s memories.

BREAK THE CYCLE:
In Hollow 2, exploring and surviving won’t be enough to learn your past and unravel all secrets. With re-designed, fast, and friendly mechanics, your mission is to purge an abandoned station in order to reach your goal. Use all weapons and tools you find to make sure that not even a single creature can stand between you and the truth. Run, fight, hide, explore – do your best to destroy the Shakhter-One once and forever!
